questions.question: What was the total Medicare enrollment, in millions, in calendar year 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_medicare_enrollment.xlsx', sheet_name='Enrollment', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Calendar').any(), axis=1)].index[0]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
df_data.columns = [str(c).strip().replace('\n', ' ') for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]

year_col = df_data.columns[0]
total_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Total' in c][0]

val = df_data[df_data[year_col].astype(float) == 2023][total_col].values[0]
result = float(val)

questions.question: In what calendar year is overall Medicare enrollment projected to first exceed 100 million beneficiaries?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_medicare_enrollment.xlsx', sheet_name='Enrollment', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Calendar').any(), axis=1)].index[0]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
df_data.columns = [str(c).strip().replace('\n', ' ') for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]

year_col = df_data.columns[0]
total_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Total' in c][0]

df_data[year_col] = df_data[year_col].astype(float).astype(int)
df_data[total_col] = df_data[total_col].astype(float)

exceed_df = df_data[df_data[total_col] > 100]
result = str(exceed_df[year_col].min())

questions.question: How many more millions of people were enrolled in Part A than in Part B in 2020?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_medicare_enrollment.xlsx', sheet_name='Enrollment', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Calendar').any(), axis=1)].index[0]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
df_data.columns = [str(c).strip().replace('\n', ' ') for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]

year_col = df_data.columns[0]
part_a_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Part A' in c][0]
part_b_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Part B' in c][0]

row_2020 = df_data[df_data[year_col].astype(float) == 2020].iloc[0]
diff = float(row_2020[part_a_col]) - float(row_2020[part_b_col])
result = round(diff, 3)

questions.question: Did Medicare Part D have any enrolled beneficiaries prior to calendar year 2006?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_medicare_enrollment.xlsx', sheet_name='Enrollment', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Calendar').any(), axis=1)].index[0]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
df_data.columns = [str(c).strip().replace('\n', ' ') for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]

year_col = df_data.columns[0]
part_d_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Part D' in c][0]

df_prior = df_data[df_data[year_col].astype(float) < 2006]
has_enrollment = (df_prior[part_d_col].astype(float) > 0).any()
result = "yes" if has_enrollment else "no"

questions.question: Between 2000 and 2023 inclusive, how many calendar years saw total Medicare enrollment exceed 50 million people?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_medicare_enrollment.xlsx', sheet_name='Enrollment', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Calendar').any(), axis=1)].index[0]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
df_data.columns = [str(c).strip().replace('\n', ' ') for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]

year_col = df_data.columns[0]
total_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Total' in c][0]

df_period = df_data[(df_data[year_col].astype(float) >= 2000) & (df_data[year_col].astype(float) <= 2023)]
count = (df_period[total_col].astype(float) > 50).sum()
result = int(count)

questions.question: What was the average Part D enrollment, in millions, over the five-year period from 2006 through 2010?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_medicare_enrollment.xlsx', sheet_name='Enrollment', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.apply(lambda r: r.astype(str).str.contains('Calendar').any(), axis=1)].index[0]
df_data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1:].copy()
df_data.columns = [str(c).strip().replace('\n', ' ') for c in df.iloc[header_idx]]

year_col = df_data.columns[0]
part_d_col = [c for c in df_data.columns if 'Part D' in c][0]

df_period = df_data[(df_data[year_col].astype(float) >= 2006) & (df_data[year_col].astype(float) <= 2010)]
avg = df_period[part_d_col].astype(float).mean()
result = round(avg, 4)
